items.title: Cencora Tech Chief: AI Is Cutting Some Medical Treatment Decisions in Half
items.summary: Cencora Global Chief Data and Information Officer Pawan Verma spoke with WSJ Leadership Institute President Alan Murray at the WSJLI Technology Council Summit about how AI is being used in healthcare to speed access to treatment. Verma described a retinal oncology use case in which doctors analyze large volumes of imaging data to determine treatment, saying AI is helping cut a decision process that can take 30 to 90 days roughly in half.

items.title: The Realities of Managing Enterprise AI
